title: ArtifactAttestation
description: Produced-artifact provenance — attests which run and tool produced an artifact (file, bundle, model, report) along with its content digest, enabling verifiable artifact lineage. Carries the AEP envelope fields (schema_version, created_at_ms) plus attestation-specific keys.

trace_id.description: Optional correlation ID linking related evidence records

created_at_ms.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when the record was created (attestation time)

artifact_uri.description: URI or path identifying the produced artifact

digest.description: Content digest of the artifact, e.g. sha256:..., for tamper-evident provenance

produced_by_run_id.description: Identifier of the run that produced this artifact

tool_name.description: Name of the tool or agent that produced the artifact

signature.description: Optional tamper-evident signature over the record content
